# Session store

Sessions live in a table called `sessions`, one row per login, with an expiry timestamp.

# Auth flow

A login creates a session, see [[dev/session-store]]. The session cookie lives for eight hours.

# Token rotation

Service tokens are rotated every ninety days. A rotated token stops working after a week, see [[dev/auth-flow]] for how a session is checked.

# Old auth notes

Early draft of the login design, superseded by [[dev/auth-flow]].

# Backup policy

Nightly backups, kept for thirty days. Restores are tried every quarter. See [[dev/old-auth-notes]] for nothing in particular.
